idea: Credit layer for x402 agents on Monad: a lender vault is the payer of x402 batch settlement channels, so an AI agent holds only a voucher signing key and never unconstrained USDC. The agent gets a policy bound credit line (per channel cap, credit line, expiry, vendor allowlist, instant stop on new funding). The agent's revenue is routed to repay the loan first, its repayment record is a portable onchain credit record, and the collateral a sponsor must lock falls as that record grows.

wedge.title: monad-metropolis
wedge.sector: WEB3 · Trust, Identity & AI Infrastructure · credit layer for x402 agents
wedge.target_user: an operator running a paid AI agent that buys API calls and sells results, who will not hand it an unconstrained wallet
wedge.painful_moment: Today an operator either pre-funds the agent's own wallet (an unbounded loss if the key leaks) or pays every bill by hand; a vendor cannot tell a well behaved agent from a new one.
wedge.unusual_constraint: The agent never holds tokens. It holds only a voucher signing key; a lender vault is the payer of x402 batch settlement channels.
wedge.proof_metric: Fork tests against the real x402 batch settlement contract on Monad testnet: every policy refusal and every real-contract refusal must match its expected error (count reported by pnpm claim:verify).
wedge.essential_sponsor_role: Not integrated yet. Planned: Dynamic embedded wallet for the sponsor and agent signer.

adversarial_critique.why_generic_risk: Agent spend limits already exist on Monad (AgentPay, AgentMarket). Ours differs only if the credit record and graduating collateral are shown working.
adversarial_critique.obvious_competitor: AgentPay and other x402 payment tools with spend limits; over collateralized lending pools
adversarial_critique.unprovable_claim_risk: Revenue can be faked by an agent paying itself; only count revenue from allowlisted payers. Everything so far ran on a fork or local chain, not live Monad.
adversarial_critique.superficial_sponsor_risk: Dynamic, Privy and Envio are targeted but not yet integrated; do not claim them until they are.
adversarial_critique.hour_8_kill_criterion: If the vault plus real x402 channel cannot complete fund, voucher, claim, settle on a Monad fork, cut the graduating collateral and ship the channel funding alone.
